html:
BiRefNet (Nankai University and partners, CAAI AIR 2024): cuts the foreground out of a photo as a soft mask at full resolution (background removal), with a Swin Transformer encoder; general and lite versions. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: Bilateral Reference for High-Resolution Dichotomous Image Segmentation, CAAI AIR 2024, 2024-01-07
  • Original code: https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet at f7079632d681
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/e2bf8e4460fc8fa32bba5ea4d94b3233d367b0e4/README.md ; https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet_lite/blob/aa62cd87eafb9cc43056d08ef3615a14628b831d/README.md ; https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/f7079632d681ecf12161fcea8905682934e59e51/LICENSE
  • Training data: DIS5K (dichotomous image segmentation), DUTS (salient object detection), HRSOD (high-resolution salient object detection), UHRSD (ultra-high-resolution salient object detection), HRS10K (high-resolution salient object detection), P3M-10k (privacy-preserving portrait matting) (General-use checkpoints: DIS5K-TR, DIS-TEs, DUTS-TR/TE, HRSOD-TR/TE, UHRSD-TR/TE, HRS10K-TR/TE, TR-P3M-10k, TE-P3M-500-NP, TE-P3M-500-P, TR-humans (HF model card). Some of these sets carry research-only terms; only the weights licence (MIT) counts for the commercial flag.)
  • Kernel libraries: deform_conv
  • Variants: birefnet, birefnet-lite
  • Outputs: alpha
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): birefnet 3000x4000 (1.7 GiB peak allocated, 2.8 reserved); birefnet-lite 3000x4000 (0.9 GiB peak allocated, 1.8 reserved)
  • birefnet 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 94 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 201 s (ONNX + engine).
  • birefnet-lite 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 75 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 156 s (ONNX + engine).
  • birefnet original 1080x1920: the authors' float16 model option; HF ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet@e2bf8e4460fc birefnet.py, the card's resize / normalisation / sigmoid / resize back
  • birefnet-lite original 1080x1920: the authors' float16 model option; HF ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet_lite@aa62cd87eafb birefnet.py, the card's resize / normalisation / sigmoid / resize back
  • birefnet load / first call: original 3.6 s / 0.387 s, portable 0.75 s / 0.565 s, kernels 1.61 s / 0.44 s
  • birefnet-lite load / first call: original 8.04 s / 1.104 s, portable 0.26 s / 0.631 s, kernels 1.03 s / 0.316 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Each image at its own size against its binary mask: MAE of the alpha, max F-beta (beta^2 = 0.3) over 256 thresholds (BiRefNet's evaluation). Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
